name: accepted-async-task-polling
explain: Implement an enterprise-grade HTTP 202 Accepted asynchronous agent task pattern. Decouples long-running LLM execution from client connections with polling locations, progress tracking, and cooperative cancellation.
steps: Submit asynchronous agent task and receive HTTP 202 with Location header and retry hint. || Poll status endpoint through PENDING and RUNNING transitions until terminal COMPLETED outcome.
expect: Accepted async task lifecycle verified: status=202, terminal_state=COMPLETED, progress=1.0

name: cross-process-task-state-store
explain: Demonstrate why process-local state fails across distributed replicas and container restarts, and implement a durable, shared task repository with optimistic locking, heartbeat lease renewal, and zombie worker reconciliation.
steps: Demonstrate that process-local in-memory registries fail on node queries and pod restarts. || Implement shared durable repository with optimistic versioning and heartbeat reconciliation across replicas.
expect: Distributed task store verified: local_cross_node_found=False, durable_cross_node_found=True, zombie_reconciled=True

name: async-resource-lifecycle-boundary
explain: Demonstrate async event loop protection and database transaction boundary hygiene. Prevents connection pool starvation by releasing database sessions before external LLM awaits, and offloads blocking CPU tasks to bounded thread pools.
steps: Release database transaction and connection before awaiting long-running LLM generation. || Offload CPU-bound token parsing to bounded thread executor to keep event loop latency non-blocking.
expect: Resource boundary verified: db_held_during_llm=False, max_active_connections=1, loop_lag_ms<50

name: delegated-capability-attenuation
explain: Implement cryptographic capability attenuation for cross-service agent delegation. Prevents ambient authority escalation by minting scoped, short-lived HMAC delegation tokens restricted to exact resources and actions.
steps: Mint attenuated sub-token from root orchestrator credentials restricting scope and validity window. || Enforce capability attenuation at downstream service, rejecting cross-document access and unauthorized actions.
expect: Delegated capability attenuation verified: permitted_read=True, forbidden_cross_doc=403, forbidden_action=403
